01

Why this
matters to you

Not because the numbers are good. Because of what operating changes about how we advise.

Consequence 01

We have signed the invoice

We know what it feels like to approve a marketing spend that might not work, with money that is also payroll. That changes what we recommend and how confidently we recommend it.

Consequence 02

We have run the playbook end to end

Positioning, identity, site, automation, campaigns, expansion. Not as five projects for five clients — as one business, in sequence, over four years.

Consequence 03

We know which parts are hard

The sequence on this site is not theory about what should work. It is the order we found out actually works, including the two things we did in the wrong order first.

Consequence 04

We cannot hide behind the deck

If our advice were wrong, our own business would show it. That is a more uncomfortable form of accountability than a case study, and a more useful one for you.

02

What we got
wrong first

The part that usually gets left out.

Mistake 01

We ran ads too early

Before the positioning was settled. It worked badly and we blamed the creative for two months before admitting the problem was upstream.

Mistake 02

We sold class packs too long

The offer contradicted the position. A third space is somewhere you belong, not somewhere you visit nine more times.

Mistake 03

We under-built the system

The first identity worked for one studio and broke at three. Now we build every system against the hardest application, not the first one.
